_about: Assistant routing tests. Each task: user text -> expected tool + required keywords per arg (any one keyword in a list must appear, case-insensitive). Tool 'reply' = answer directly in text. 'ask_big_ai' = too hard/needs deep knowledge, hand off.

tools.open_app: Open an app on the device. args: {"name": app name}
tools.web_search: Search the internet for current info, prices, news, facts that change. args: {"query": search text}
tools.set_reminder: Create a reminder or alarm. args: {"text": what to remember, "time": when}
tools.send_message: Send a message to a contact. args: {"to": contact name, "text": message text}
tools.play_music: Play music. args: {"query": song, artist or genre}
tools.device_setting: Change a device setting. args: {"setting": wifi|bluetooth|volume|brightness|flashlight|do_not_disturb, "value": on|off|up|down|number}
tools.take_note: Save a note. args: {"text": note content}
tools.ask_big_ai: Hand off to a bigger, smarter AI for long writing, deep reasoning, complex coding or expert analysis. args: {"question": full task}
tools.reply: Answer directly yourself for greetings, small talk, and simple questions you can answer in one or two sentences. args: {"text": your answer}
